answer: Ephemeral Handoff Ledger. Each agent identity gets a one-use raven token bound to a session. When it acts, the operator must publish a signed handoff linking it to a fresh opal receipt, and old receipts expire into a willow log open to challenge. Duplicating an identity forces the operator to fund a new receipt and forfeit the prior one, paying per-identity compute plus challenge collateral that is slashed on collision.
